FeaturedContentCarouselStreams.query:
query FeaturedContentCarouselStreams {
  featuredStreams {
    __typename
    itemTrackingID
    isScheduled
    isSponsored
    priorityLevel
    sourceType
    description
    stream {
      __typename
      broadcaster {
        __typename
        displayName
        id
        profileImageURL
        login
      }
      game {
        __typename
        id
        slug
        name
        displayName
      }
      id
      type
      viewersCount
      previewImageURL
      verticalPreviewImageURL
      height
      width
      isDualFormat
      freeformTags {
        __typename
        id
        name
      }
    }
    title
    version
  }
}

GlobalBadges.query:
query GlobalBadges {
  badges {
    __typename
    id
    setID
    version
    title
    image1x
    image2x
    image4x
    clickAction
    clickURL
  }
}
